text:
𝗔𝗨𝗦 𝗪𝗜𝗡 𝗔 𝗧𝗛𝗥𝗜𝗟𝗟𝗘𝗥! 🔥

Australia 191/7 (19.5) beat England 187/9 by 3 wickets at the MCG.
Chaudhary 66 off 38; Edwards 25* off 11.

Best chase you've seen? 👇
#AUSvENG #Cricket

facebook.caption:
𝗔𝘂𝘀𝘁𝗿𝗮𝗹𝗶𝗮 𝗻𝗲 𝗷𝗲𝗲𝘁𝗮 𝘁𝗵𝗿𝗶𝗹𝗹𝗲𝗿! 🔥

👉 MCG par Australia ne England ke 187/9 ka peecha 19.5 over mein 191/7 banakar kiya
👉 Nikhil Chaudhary ke 66 (38 gend) ne match palta
👉 Jack Edwards ne 11 gend mein 25* thokkar finish kiya
👉 5 match ki series mein Australia 1-0 aage

Kaisa laga ye chase? Comment karo 👇
